description: Authoring profiles and proposed validator checks. No production validation engine is installed by this registry. Patterns are canonical recommendations; observed plugin aliases must be handled separately.

normalization.casePolicy: Preserve template spelling; case-insensitive detection is a plugin behavior, not universal production proof.
normalization.identityScope: source + owning component ID + owning parent ID + layer ID; normalized state keys are unique only among siblings

rules.title: Identity and ancestry
rules.check: Manifest layer IDs are unique, parent references resolve to layers or the declared root sentinel, and ancestry is acyclic.
rules.exclusions: Duplicate display names are allowed under different parents.
rules.repair: Resolve malformed IDs/parent references through the exporter; do not rename artwork to mask identity errors.

rules.title: Excluded subtrees
rules.check: Retain dot-prefixed nodes for audit but exclude their entire subtree from the active export profile.
rules.exclusions: Saved visibility false is not equivalent to exclusion.
rules.repair: Review intended export eligibility before changing an exclusion prefix.

rules.title: Name normalization ledger
rules.check: Compare raw and normalized names; record LRP's trailing 2xl removal separately from structural changes.
rules.exclusions: Do not remove arbitrary suffixes or equate 2xl with the plugin's excluded 2x duplicate marker.
rules.repair: Select the matching exporter normalization profile and retain original names.

rules.title: Contextual component matching
rules.check: Select a component profile by anchored name, node kind and owning context; unknown or ambiguous instances need review.
rules.exclusions: A permissive plugin substring match alone does not confirm a supported production component.
rules.repair: Use the intended template name or register a verified alternate profile.

rules.title: Scoped state identity
rules.check: Accepted normalized state keys are unique among direct siblings of the same owner.
rules.exclusions: Repeated slide1 under separate categories or targets is valid.
rules.repair: Inspect duplicate IDs and paths; rename only an unintended duplicate state.

rules.title: Control and state separation
rules.check: Collect state candidates only along the component profile's state paths, preserving controls and configuration in their own roles.
rules.exclusions: Dotter and Map generate content from data and require no authored slideN.
rules.repair: Restore the intended owner of the misplaced state or control.

rules.title: Frame ownership
rules.check: When a frame-derived profile is selected, resolve at most one direct frame shape as the geometry candidate.
rules.exclusions: Never use a descendant or neighboring component's frame as an automatic substitute.
rules.repair: Resolve duplicate direct frames against the intended template and keep the correct owner.

rules.title: Component bounds policy
rules.check: Choose bounds policy by component/profile; missing frame is advisory until its necessity is confirmed.
rules.exclusions: Category slides, Static Product slides, Color Picker slides, map image buttons and arbitrary artwork groups need no universal frame rule.
rules.repair: Use the intended profile and verify the compiler's actual geometry source.

rules.title: Order and numbering
rules.check: Record Photoshop panel order and numeric state order separately; flag ambiguous duplicates or mixed sequence direction for review.
rules.exclusions: Ascending and descending panel sequences are both accepted by existing plugin tests; number gaps alone do not establish failure.
rules.repair: Confirm intended state order and layering before changing either.

rules.title: State ownership and visibility
rules.check: Enumerate state paths within their owners, preserve persistent siblings, and verify initial/selected runtime state.
rules.exclusions: Comparison before/after surfaces may coexist; hidden saved states and closed Hotspots can be legitimate.
rules.repair: Correct the component state adapter using matched runtime behavior.

rules.title: Wrapper and nesting support
rules.check: Preserve wrappers and report when the selected consumer cannot discover all components or exceeds its supported nesting depth.
rules.exclusions: A tool limit is not a PSD or production-invalid verdict.
rules.repair: Extend discovery with an evidenced component path or use a verified supported arrangement.

rules.title: Asset, action and feed references
rules.check: Resolve referenced feeds, assets and action targets within their owning component/package; preserve data tokens.
rules.exclusions: Configuration filename layers, native text and vector shapes do not necessarily have corresponding raster PNGs.
rules.repair: Supply the matched data/asset or correct the documented reference without stripping its semantic token.

rules.title: CTA authoring contract
rules.check: CTA groups must be named buttonN with a positive integer suffix and contain a direct frame. A text label is permitted without a prescribed literal name. Any direct image/Smart Object used as CTA background must be named exactly background; its presence is optional.
rules.exclusions: Apply only to contextual CTA groups, not map Smart Object buttons, other action profiles or arbitrary artwork. Runtime frame promotion and stacking remain unverified.
rules.repair: Review CTA group naming, add the required frame, and name the optional background image/Smart Object background. Preserve legacy evidence; do not silently rename source layers.

exceptions: Controls are not universally mandatory.
Persistent gallery-level CTA differs from slide-owned CTA.
A frame on every slide is not a universal requirement.
components.runtimeStatus: Historical RM/CTA issue evidence exists; matched live state traversal not evaluated in this pass.

home/categoryN tiles are not root categoryN content states.
navBar/home is a shape control, not the home state.

Resolve master/dotterGallery1/dataFile/dotterFeed.json by matching component instance.
Preserve feed tokens and nested product/retailer templates.
